note: Somalia: Malaysians and Rwandans enter without a visa for 30 days; nationals of the countries listed get a 30-day visa on arrival; every other visitor needs an approved eVisa (eTAS) before travelling, mandatory since 1 September 2025. Somaliland keeps a separate policy, which the game doesn't model apart. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Immigration and Citizenship Agency's notice (all foreign nationals apply online from 1 September 2025); the exceptions stand on Wikipedia's copy, the civil aviation circular that lists them being unreachable.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Somalia
sources.said: Visitors to Somalia must obtain an eTAS unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Somaliland maintains a separate visa policy. ... Citizens of the following countries may enter Somalia without a visa for up to 30 days: Malaysia Rwanda Visa on arrival [ edit ] Citizens of the following countries can obtain a visa on arrival valid for 30 days: Algeria Burundi Comoros Djibouti Egypt Ethiopia Libya Mauritania Tanzania Tunisia Uganda ... This system, launched on August 28, 2025, became mandatory for all foreign visitors starting September 1, 2025.

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Agency (Federal Government of Somalia): Somalia Launches Electronic Visa (E-Visa / ETAS) System (1 September 2025)
sources.said: Effective 1 September 2025, all foreign nationals wishing to travel to Somalia are required to apply for their entry authorisation online, in advance of their journey. ... Travellers are advised to rely only on the official platform at etas.gov.so
